messages:
marta: Quick kickoff — proposing an incremental-degradation rollout for the new routing fallback layer. want canaries + opt-in cohorts + a clear kill-switch plan.
sean: +1. want to avoid 100% failover flips. suggest 3-tiered fallback: local cache -> cheaper quantized model -> remote fallback API. each with separate SLOs.
jess: agree. we'll need explicit gating for quality regressions. propose A/B for the cheaper model (metric: top1 exact match and latency tail).
rishi: proposal for traffic slices: internal dev 5%, early-beta 10%, existing paying customers 20%, public ramp 30% -> 100% if stable. each step min 24h and validation checks.
emily: canaries by region too — EU/NA first, then APAC. region windows should respect local peak hours (avoid midnight rollouts).
marta: here's a suggested flag config (draft):
```yaml
feature: routing_fallback_v2
variants:
  - name: control
    fallback: none
  - name: tiered_fallback
    rollout:
      internal: 5
      beta: 10
      paying: 20
      public: 30
slo_checks:
  - name: latency_p95
    threshold_ms: 450
  - name: quality_top1
    delta_pct: -1.5
kill_switch: immediate_disable
``` 
sean: love the explicit SLO deltas. add automated rollback if error_rate spikes > 3x baseline in 15m window.
jess: for A/B we should do paired prompt sets. run the old vs new on 2k prompts daily during canary and compute significance.
emily: ops note — we need alerting on the routing counts per tier + a synthetic user path that validates end-to-end KV cache correctness.
rishi: deploy-bot: scheduling canary window: start 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT for NA; EU start 2026-04-02 14:00 UTC. canary duration 48h per region. :clock1:
deploy-bot: canary checklist: feature flag enabled -> metric collection active -> pairing dataset running -> rollback policy attached. run `./scripts/check_canary.sh` to validate.
marta: next steps: product docs + acceptance criteria (list above), set SRE runbook with exact alert thresholds, and schedule a one-hour shiproom 24h before public ramp. any objections?
sean: none. I'll own the A/B evaluation and will post the paired results channel once complete.
jess: I'll own the prompt set and significance tests. will add pass/fail script to the canary pipeline.
emily: ops will add dashboards and the synthetic path. will also enable extra log retention for the canary window.
marta: great — tagging followups: @sean @jess @emily @rishi. putting this thread as the single source for rollout decisions. :white_check_mark:
